image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a dark, textured rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates surrounded by a reddish-brown leathery girdle. The plates are beige/tan with visible growth lines and texture. The background consists of wet rock with minor marine encrustations.
